answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method comprehensively on various benchmarks and two LLMs, including long-input, long output tasks such as long-context summarization tasks: QMSum, GovReport and Novel Summarization and HTML to TSV task from LongProc benchmark. We also propose a new task, Chain-of-key generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text sequences for summarization, HTML to TSV conversion, and chain-of-key generation.

answer_2.quote: We report perplexity... ROUGE-L for summarization tasks and row-level F-1 score for the HTML to TSV task... We report accuracy of the output...
